# Markdown Wizard

> Free online tool to convert Markdown to rich text and rich text to Markdown. Designed for cleaning up and reformatting output from AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

Markdown Wizard runs entirely in the browser — no signup, no upload, no account required. It also includes a citation cleaner, a Markdown link generator, and a humanize-text tool.

## Pages

- [Markdown Converter](/): Convert between Markdown and rich text, with citation cleaning and plain/rich formatting options.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How visitor data and optional newsletter signups are handled.
- [Terms of Use](/terms): Terms governing use of the tool.
